title: Coking coal reserves limited, steel industry continues relying on imports: TV Narendran
dek: TV Narendran says India's coking coal reserves are limited and the steel industry continues to rely on imports, according to PSU Watch.
summary: According to a PSU Watch headline, TV Narendran said coking coal reserves are limited and the steel industry continues to rely on imports. The publisher did not provide an excerpt, and no import volumes or figures are given.
keyFacts: Coking coal reserves described as limited
Steel industry continues to rely on imports
whyItMatters: Dependence on imported coking coal leaves Indian blast-furnace producers exposed to seaborne price and supply swings.
implications: Producers may keep pursuing diversified sourcing and lower-coal process routes. Traders should expect sustained import demand.
